subject.title: feat: add jsonl support to memory indexer

question: Should builtin `memorySearch.extraPaths` ingest arbitrary raw JSONL logs, or should raw JSONL recall stay outside the builtin Markdown/multimodal memory path?
rationale: Current code and docs intentionally center builtin memory on Markdown plus narrow multimodal/session surfaces, while raw-log ingestion would widen sensitive memory visibility and file-format support.

options.title: Document Supported Alternative
options.body: Keep builtin memory Markdown/multimodal-only and document QMD, session-memory, converter, or plugin-owned workflows for raw JSONL recall.

options.title: Add Native Builtin JSONL
options.body: Implement JSONL as a first-class builtin memory format with line-aware chunking, watcher and `memory_get` support, tests, docs, and privacy guardrails.

options.title: Defer For Plugin API Design
options.body: Keep the issue open until maintainers decide whether a plugin or memory API extension should own arbitrary raw-log ingestion.

recommendation.title: Document Supported Alternative
recommendation.body: Keep builtin memory Markdown/multimodal-only and document QMD, session-memory, converter, or plugin-owned workflows for raw JSONL recall.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has current history in the affected memory host/runtime boundary and already commented with maintainer-side context on this issue.
